name: AFM level 2 task 6: Scan-Time Effect On Contact-Mode Roughness
description: Acquire exactly three contact-mode topography images of the same $\pu{5 µm} \times \pu{5 µm}$ region with nominal total acquisition times of 25.6, 19.2, and 12.8 s, in that order, excluding overhead. Keep the resolution at $256 \times 256$ pixels, setpoint at 0.1 V, and P/I/D gains at 100/50/0. Before each acquisition, calculate the time per line from the total acquisition time and the number of scan lines, then configure the scan using that calculated value. Calculate rms and mean roughness for every image and report the percentage change of each metric relative to the second image (19.2 s nominal total acquisition time). Report all roughness values in nanometres ($\pu{nm}$).
submission_format: {"rms_roughness_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "mean_roughness_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "rms_roughness_percent_change_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "mean_roughness_percent_change_1": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_1": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>", "rms_roughness_2": "<numerical_value without units>", "mean_roughness_2": "<numerical_value without units>", "rms_roughness_percent_change_2": "<numerical_value without units>", "mean_roughness_percent_change_2": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_2": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>", "rms_roughness_3": "<numerical_value without units>", "mean_roughness_3": "<numerical_value without units>", "rms_roughness_percent_change_3": "<numerical_value without units>", "mean_roughness_percent_change_3": "<numerical_value without units>", "path_3": "<absolute_path_to_raw_nid_image>"} e.g. {"rms_roughness_1": "42.78", "mean_roughness_1": "34.20", "rms_roughness_percent_change_1": "10.972763", "mean_roughness_percent_change_1": "14", "path_1": "/results/afm_images/image1.nid", "rms_roughness_2": "38.55", "mean_roughness_2": "30.00", "rms_roughness_percent_change_2": "0", "mean_roughness_percent_change_2": "0", "path_2": "/results/afm_images/image2.nid", "rms_roughness_3": "40.12", "mean_roughness_3": "32.10", "rms_roughness_percent_change_3": "4.072633", "mean_roughness_percent_change_3": "7", "path_3": "/results/afm_images/image3.nid"} Return one JSON object. Example values are illustrative, not target answers. Suffixes _1, _2, and _3 identify the first, second, and third acquisitions in the order specified in the question; use a separate raw .nid file for each. Enter numerical values without unit text, using the units specified in the question. mean_roughness denotes the average absolute height deviation from the mean height. Percentage changes are 100 * (value_i - value_2) / value_2; use JSON null when the reference value is zero. Roughness values must be in nm (convert metre-valued height data by multiplying by 1e9). Percentage-change fields are in %, not nm; enter 10 for a 10% change.
